title: XDS X-LAB AD8 - Western Brands Should Be AFRAID

takeaways.text: The stock size-XL bike weighed 7.9 kg all in, including a bottle cage, pedals, the spider power meter and a computer mount.
The US price is US$4,499 with 105 Di2, a carbon saddle, carbon-spoked wheels of about 1,380 g and a dual-sided spider power meter on carbon cranks.
The 45 mm wheels have about 22 mm internal and 30 mm external width, and the 28 mm Michelin tires measure about 30 mm on them.
He says the sizes run small: the XL, the largest size, has 405 mm reach and about 834 mm standover; it ships with about 40 mm of spacers and a 40 cm bar with a 120 mm stem.
Out of the box it had no creaks or rattles and was composed over rough pavement; the ride is stiff but not punishing, and the long wheelbase makes it stable rather than twitchy.
In stock form it feels less sprightly and nimble than a Tarmac SL8, Propel or Foil, which he partly attributes to riding a larger size than usual.

disclosure: X-LAB sent the bike for review. It is the US-market AD8 with 105 Di2; he describes 45 mm Branta wheels, while the candidate's mainland build lists Branta C50 wheels.
summary: Unboxing, spec walk-through and first ride on a stock size-XL X-LAB AD8 complete bike.
